description: This 3D model depicts a low-poly, retro-style computer desk setup. The desk itself has a simple wooden top and dark metal legs. On the desk are vintage computing peripherals: a beige desktop tower, a CRT monitor, a beige keyboard, a mouse, a telephone, and a floppy disk. There's also a CD-ROM and a document with a pen. A small filing cabinet is integrated under the desk. A rolling office chair with a beige seat and dark frame is placed in front of the desk. The overall aesthetic suggests a nostalgic look at early personal computing.
